full_prompt_en: A square raw expressionist painting shows a distorted face pressed close to the picture plane against a dirty pink and off-white ground. One oversized round eye dominates the upper center-right of the selected panel, with a black pupil surrounded by thick white and gray rings. A dark uneven eyebrow arches above it beneath a mass of black hair or paint that fills the top-right corner. The long triangular nose extends down toward the left, built from scraped cream, gray, and brown strokes rather than smooth flesh. Below it, a dark mouth opens into a jagged shape lined by short black marks that suggest broken teeth. Broad red-brown and black swipes cover the lower cheek and jaw, and the face continues beyond the right and bottom edges. At left, pale ground remains visible beneath looping black scribbles, drips, and scratchy line fragments. A muted gold or ocher angular piece cuts into the top edge above the dark head, but its exact form is unclear. Small white scrawls near the lower-right edge are too irregular to read as words. Paint appears layered, partly scraped back, and allowed to run in narrow vertical trails. The viewpoint is frontal and extremely close, leaving no room or landscape around the head. Light is not a natural source in the scene; the brightest values come from opaque white paint around the eye and nose against heavy black marks. The overall composition is crowded and unstable, using the single eye, abrasive surface, and clashing pink-red-black palette for confrontational energy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、原始粗粝的表现主义绘画在脏粉与灰白底面上呈现一张紧贴画面的变形面孔。所选单图上部中右的一只巨大圆眼占据主导，黑瞳孔外包围厚重白灰色圆环。参差的深色眉毛弯在眼上，下方是填满右上角的黑发或黑色颜料团。细长三角鼻向左下伸出，由刮擦的乳白、灰和棕色笔触组成，而非平滑肤色。其下深色嘴巴张成参差形，边缘有短短黑痕，让人联想到破碎牙齿。宽阔的红棕与黑色刷痕覆盖下脸颊和下颌，面孔继续延伸出右缘与下缘。左侧浅底面仍可见，布满环绕黑色涂写、滴痕和刮擦线段。头部上方有一块低饱和金或赭色棱角形从上缘切入，但无法确定是什么。右下附近零散白色涂写过于不规则，不能读成文字。颜料层层覆盖，部分又被刮去，并形成狭窄竖向流痕。视点正面且极近，头周围没有房间或风景。场景中没有自然光源；最亮明度来自眼与鼻周围不透明的白色颜料，对照浓重黑色笔痕。整体构图拥挤且不稳定，以独眼、磨蚀般的表面和冲撞的粉红、红、黑色盘带来直接逼人的能量。
style_prompt_en: Raw expressionist painting layers opaque swipes, scratched back passages, drips, and wandering black linework. Dirty rose, crimson, rust, off-white, and near-black collide without smooth blending. One high-contrast circular focal mark can hold attention amid irregular angular masses and half-erased details. Edges are torn, smeared, or aggressively redrawn; surface wear and accidental-looking marks remain visible. Illumination is graphic rather than naturalistic, created by blunt white pigment against dark neighboring strokes. Tight cropping allows the image to push beyond its own borders. The overall effect is abrasive, urgent, and deliberately unstable.
style_prompt_zh: 原始表现主义绘画层叠不透明刷痕、刮回的区域、滴痕和游走的黑线。脏玫瑰粉、绯红、锈色、灰白与近黑相互冲撞，没有平滑混色。单个高反差圆形焦点能在不规则棱角色团和被部分擦去的细节中抓住注意力。边缘被撕开、抹开或强硬重描；表面磨损与仿佛偶然留下的痕迹都清楚可见。照明是图形性的，而非自然主义，由钝重白颜料对照邻近深色笔痕建立。紧贴的裁切让图像仿佛向边框外推进。整体效果粗砺、急迫且刻意不稳定。
theme_en: A distorted single-eyed face rendered in rough red, black, and white paint
theme_zh: 一张变形的独眼面孔由粗粝红黑白颜料绘出
name: Jonathan Meese
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
